_note: M42 = the M40 / M41 recipe with a longer schedule, fixed before training: M41 was still improving at its last allowed epoch (9), so stage B may run up to 40 epochs with patience 8, and it fine-tunes backbone layers 4-8 instead of only layer 8. Data: ai_training/data/manifests_m42 (M41 data with the audit fixes and the human-reviewed collared-neck / regular-sleeve labels). Proxy garment-type labels (merchant category, navel rule) keep weight 0.5; rule-derived and pseudo labels are not used. One run only; the checkpoint is chosen by validation mean macro-F1.
